text:
Alex Chen: AM async — quick standup. What I did: pushed kernel patch (PR #742) to reduce microbatch flushes and tightened the slot allocator backpressure. Blocker: seeing intermittent KV eviction spikes on p95 when we get a burst of short chat requests; suspect slot stealing + aggressive prefetch. Today: run targeted perf sweep & add counters to batcher to capture slot_reassignments and KV eviction reasons.

Maria R: Nice. Which harness are you using for the sweep? can you drop numbers here once done? :eyes:

Alex Chen: Using benchkit v2 with local canary (`benchkit run --profile short-reqs`). Repro command I'm using:```scripts/run_warmup.sh --shards 4 --profile short-reqs --duration 5m```Will attach summaries.

Samir: FYI I hit a similar p95 blip on canary yesterday — eviction rate tracked w/ slot steal events. Left a small comment on your PR that adds `slot_reassignments` logging. Might help correlate.

Alex Chen: Thanks @Samir — saw the comment, will merge that log into the next test build. Also cc @ops-bot for a quick grafana snapshot during the run.

ops-bot: Grafana snapshot created: https://grafana.redwood/d/evict/kv-evict-snap?orgId=1 (auto) :white_check_mark:

Maria R: If p95 stays > 150ms we should try disabling microbatching for this model on canary; easier short-term mitigation.

Alex Chen: Quick sweep results (first 5m run): p50 34ms, p95 198ms, p99 430ms. Eviction spikes line up with bursts around t+120s and t+210s. Output excerpt:```[2026-03-18T09:02:04Z] slot_reassignments=6 kv_evictions=42 evict_reason=kv_pressure
[2026-03-18T09:05:27Z] slot_reassignments=2 kv_evictions=8 evict_reason=slot_steal``` Planning: (1) add counter export for `slot_reassignments`, (2) try evict_threshold_ms=500 for canary, (3) run another 10m with the new logs.

Ian: +1 on exporting counters. Also suggest toggling `evict_threshold_ms` and `cache_target_size` together — sometimes threshold alone moves more pressure into allocation.

Samir: Quick note — when you change `evict_threshold_ms`, check the microbatch latency tail. Disabling microbatching will raise p50 but may cut p95 for short requests.

Alex Chen: Good call. I'll run three permutations: baseline / threshold=500 / microbatch=off and post the p50/p95/p99. Leaving this async — ping me if you want me to run a specific model or customer shard.

Maria R: Thanks — if you can tag me with the run IDs I'll add them to the perf dashboard and file an eval alert if regressions appear.

Alex Chen: Will do. Run IDs -> 20260318-a1 (baseline), 20260318-b1 (threshold500), 20260318-c1 (microbatch-off). Posting results in ~30m. :coffee:
